Broken.Title: {segment} is Broken
Broken.Body: {colossus}’s {segment} is Broken ({n} token(s)) and can’t use actions or reactions until all tokens are cleared.

Repaired.Title: {segment} recovers
Repaired.Body: The last token is cleared: the {segment} is no longer Broken.

Destroyed.Title: {segment} Destroyed
Destroyed.Body: {colossus}’s {segment} marks its last Hit Point and is Destroyed. It can’t use any of its features, but it’s still there: PCs can climb on and across it.

Cascade.Title: Cascade
Cascade.Body: The {from} is Destroyed: the {to} marks {n} HP.

Collapsed.Title: {colossus} Collapses
Collapsed.Body: {colossus} is Collapsed: segments that aren’t accessible from the ground can now be climbed.
Collapsed.Permanent: {colossus} is Collapsed for good: every segment can be climbed from the ground.

Risen.Title: {colossus} rises again
Risen.Body: {colossus} is no longer Collapsed. Segments high above the ground are out of reach again.

Rider.Thrown: {name} is thrown off {colossus} onto the ground!
Rider.FallDamage: {colossus} is flying: a PC who hits the ground takes {damage} physical damage.

ShakeOff.Title: {colossus} shakes off foes
ShakeOff.Body: Targets who fail their Strength Reaction Roll fall to the ground and mark a HP. Click who falls:

Defeated.Title: {colossus} is defeated!
Defeated.Fatal: Its fatal segment, the {segment}, is Destroyed.
Defeated.Chain: Every segment in Chain {chain} is Destroyed.
Defeated.Shard: The soul shard {colossus} guarded shatters deep beneath the earth, and a ring of essentia erupts from the ground a mile around it.

Card.Swarm: {name} acts inside the {segment} and marks {n} Stress fighting off Kelir’s children.

Damage.Title: {segment} of {colossus}
Damage.Summary: Colossus rules changed the HP marked from {from} to {to}:
Damage.NoHp: The {segment} has no Hit Points and takes no damage.
Damage.Invulnerable: Invulnerable: the {segment} takes no damage now.
Damage.Protected: Protected: the {segment} can’t be damaged now.
Damage.Strike: Strike: the {segment} is immune to damage from attacks not made within {range} range.
Damage.WeakPoint: Weak Point: the {segment} marks an additional HP.

Rule.fatal: Fatal: when it’s Destroyed, the colossus is defeated
Rule.chain: Chain: when every segment of the chain is Destroyed, the colossus is defeated
Rule.strike: Strike: immune to damage from attacks not made within this range
Rule.armored: Armored: marks 1 fewer HP from an attack
Rule.weakPoint: Weak Point: marks an additional HP from attacks within Melee range
Rule.invulnerable: Invulnerable: takes no damage (or only while Broken)
Rule.protected: Protected: can’t be damaged until its condition is met
Rule.climbing: Climbing: changes the Difficulty to climb it
Rule.cascade: Cascade: when it’s Destroyed, another segment marks HP
Rule.collapse: Collapse: the colossus Collapses when its trigger is met
Rule.riderStress: Action rolls on this segment cost a Stress

dhcoBroken.Name: Broken
dhcoBroken.Short: This segment can’t use actions or reactions until the condition is cleared.

dhcoDestroyed.Name: Destroyed
dhcoDestroyed.Short: This segment marked its last Hit Point and can’t use any of its features.

dhcoCollapsed.Name: Collapsed
dhcoCollapsed.Short: The colossus has collapsed: segments that aren’t accessible from the ground can be climbed.

dhcoShaken.Name: Shaken
dhcoShaken.Short: You don’t gain Hope on a result with Hope; instead, clear the Shaken condition.
dhcoShaken.Blocked: {name} is Shaken: no Hope from this roll, and Shaken is cleared.

dhcoRattled.Name: Rattled
dhcoRattled.Short: You have disadvantage on reaction rolls until your next roll with Hope.

dhcoTrapped.Name: Trapped
dhcoTrapped.Short: Trapped inside the colossus until the segment holding you takes Major or greater damage.

Notify.NoGM: A GM needs to be connected to change the colossus.
Notify.NoCore: The Daggerheart Core Rulebook module isn’t active.
Notify.NoCoreModule: Colossus: the Daggerheart Core Rulebook module (daggerheart-core) isn’t active. The colossi’s art and the rulebook links come from it.
Notify.Destroyed: The {segment} is Destroyed and can’t use any of its features.
Notify.Broken: The {segment} is Broken and can’t use actions or reactions until all its tokens are cleared.
Notify.RiderImmune: The {segment}’s standard attack can’t be used on a PC riding it ({names}). Use another segment.
Notify.RiderAdvantage: {name} is on that segment: advantage on the attack.
Notify.NoCharacter: Select your character’s token (or set your character) to climb.
Notify.NotOnScene: Place the colossus on the scene to open its board.
Notify.NoBaseActor: This segment’s actor isn’t in the world, so its layout can’t be saved. Import the colossus first.

Board.Title: Colossus Board
Board.EmptyBody: Drag a colossus framework from the Colossi compendium onto the scene: its segments are placed with it and appear here.
Board.Thresholds: Damage thresholds (Major / Severe), shared by every segment
Board.EditHint: Drag cards to move them, drag the corner to resize, double-click a name to rename, click two cards to link or unlink them
Board.Editing: Drag cards to move, drag a corner to resize, double-click a name to rename. Click one card, then another, to link or unlink them as adjacent.
Board.ArrangeHint: Place the segment tokens on the canvas in the shape of the board, around the framework token
Board.GroundOn: Can be climbed from the ground (click to change)
Board.GroundOff: Out of reach from the ground until the colossus is Collapsed (click to change)
Board.ClimbHint: Climb or leap here: Agility or Strength Roll, Difficulty {n}
Board.NoSegments: This colossus has no segments on the scene.
Board.MeHint: Climb onto a segment from the ground, or leap to a segment adjacent to the one you’re on. While on a segment you have advantage on attacks against it, and its standard attack can’t be used on you.
Board.NoCharacter: Select your character’s token to climb the colossus.
Board.GMHint: Click a card to select its token, right-click to target it. Drag a portrait to move a PC without a roll.
Board.ClimbPrompt: Climb onto {colossus}’s {to}: make an action roll against Difficulty {difficulty}.
Board.LeapPrompt: Leap from the {from} to the {to}: make an action roll against Difficulty {difficulty}.

Why.notFromGround: This segment is out of reach from the ground until the colossus is Collapsed.
Why.notAdjacent: You can only leap to a segment adjacent to the one you’re on.

Drylands.Title: Emergence of Kudamat
Drylands.Heading: Emergence of Kudamat
Drylands.Sub: Kudamat siphons power from his soul shards while the party rests. Every colossus slain shatters one.
Drylands.KudamatDescription: The god in Godfell Mountain, emerged with a Power of {power}.

PhaseBody.hunt: A colossus has risen. Rests taken now mark the Siphoning Track.
PhaseBody.interlude: Time for smaller, personal tasks across the Drylands. Rests don’t mark the track.

Drylands.TrackHint: Starts with one slot marked. Short rest during a hunt: mark 1. Long rest: mark 2. When a colossus is defeated or the track is full, roll a d12 per marked slot.
Drylands.PowerHint: If he emerged now: Major threshold {major}, Severe threshold {severe}.
Drylands.AlreadySlain: {name} is already among the colossi slain.

Emerges.Title: Kudamat emerges
Emerges.Slain: All nine colossi are slain. Kudamat emerges from Godfell Mountain with a Power of {power}.
Emerges.Power: Kudamat’s Power reaches {power}. He emerges from Godfell Mountain.
Emerges.Thresholds: Build him as a Colossus adversary: Major threshold {major}, Severe threshold {severe}.

Drylands.Built: Kudamat is built as a colossus framework (Major {major}, Severe {severe}). Add his segments in the Colossus tab of his settings.
Drylands.ResetConfirm: Reset the Siphoning Track, Kudamat’s Power and the colossi slain?
Drylands.NotHunting: The party isn’t on a hunt: rests don’t mark the Siphoning Track.

LastRest.short: Last marked: a short rest on {date}.
LastRest.long: Last marked: a long rest on {date}.

Siphon.Title: Kudamat siphons
Siphon.Short: A short rest during the hunt: the Siphoning Track is at {track}/{max}.
Siphon.Long: A long rest during the hunt: the Siphoning Track is at {track}/{max}.
Siphon.Result: Kudamat’s Power rises by {gained}: {from} → {to}. The Siphoning Track resets to 1.

Shatter.Title: A soul shard shatters
Shatter.Body: With {name} slain, the soul shard it guarded shatters, and Kudamat can no longer draw on it.
Shatter.Level: The PCs immediately level up, to level {level}.

Segment.KeyHint: Short name other segments use to say they’re adjacent to this one, like “torso” or “leg”.
Segment.AdjacentHint: Keys of the segments a PC can leap to from this one, separated by commas. Leave it empty to allow every segment. You can also link cards on the board.
Segment.GroundHint: Off for segments high above the ground: they can only be reached from adjacent segments, or once the colossus is Collapsed.

damageRules.Name: Segment damage rules
damageRules.Hint: Apply Strike, Armored, Weak Point, Invulnerable and Protected when a segment takes damage, and whisper the GM what changed.

enforce.Name: Broken and Destroyed segments can’t act
enforce.Hint: Stop Broken segments from using actions and reactions, Destroyed segments from using features, and a segment’s standard attack from targeting a PC riding it.

riderAdvantage.Name: Advantage while riding
riderAdvantage.Hint: A PC on a segment has advantage on attacks against that segment.

collapse.Name: Collapse automatically
collapse.Hint: Collapse the colossus when a segment’s Collapse feature is triggered (legs marked or Destroyed).

climbRolls.Name: Roll to climb
climbRolls.Hint: Climbing onto a segment or leaping to another asks for an Agility or Strength Roll against the segment’s Difficulty. Off: climbing just moves the PC.

moveTokens.Name: Move PC tokens onto segments
moveTokens.Hint: When a PC climbs onto a segment, move their token onto the segment’s token.

autoArrange.Name: Arrange segment tokens
autoArrange.Hint: When a colossus is placed, arrange its segment tokens in the shape of the colossus instead of scattering them.

arrangeScale.Name: Arrangement scale
arrangeScale.Hint: Grid squares per board cell when arranging segment tokens on the canvas.

conditions.Name: Shaken, Rattled and Trapped conditions
conditions.Hint: Add the colossi’s conditions as token statuses. Shaken blocks the Hope of the next roll with Hope; Rattled gives disadvantage on reaction rolls until the next roll with Hope.

campaign.Name: Emergence of Kudamat
campaign.Hint: Track the Siphoning Track, Kudamat’s Power and the colossi slain, and offer to shatter the soul shard when a colossus is defeated.

autoSiphon.Name: Rests mark the Siphoning Track
autoSiphon.Hint: During a hunt, a short rest marks the track once and a long rest twice.

restWindow.Name: Rest window (minutes)
restWindow.Hint: Every PC posts their own rest card. Rests of the same kind within this many minutes count as one.

campaignPublic.Name: Players see Kudamat’s Power
campaignPublic.Hint: Siphon rolls and track changes are public. Off: only the GM sees them.
